priorityList: --- Icy Veins Rotation (Priority List) ---
Apply and maintain Sunfire and Moonfire.
Use Force of Nature outside of Eclipse if your next ability is Celestial Alignment. Only save Force of Nature if Convoke the Spirits will be off cooldown in 25-seconds.
Cast Celestial Alignment if you have just cast Force of Nature unless saving to line up with Convoke the Spirits. Then cast Wrath to spend Dream Surge unless you will cap on Astral Power.
Cast Convoke the Spirits if you have cast Force of Nature and Celestial Alignment and have less than 40-Astral Power.
Enter the Eclipse state appropriate to your target count by ending your Celestial Alignment with that filler.
Cast Force of Nature on cooldown.
Spend Dream Surge using Wrath unless you will cap on Astral Power.
Cast Starsurge to spend Astral Power, maintain Starlord, or to spend Touch the Cosmos.
Cast Wrath to generate Astral Power.
Use Warrior of Elune on cooldown. The buff will persist and the cooldown will start.
Apply and maintain Sunfire, Moonfire, and Stellar Flare (if talented).
Cast Celestial Alignment if you have just cast Fury of Elune unless saving to line up with Convoke the Spirits.
Cast Convoke the Spirits if you have cast Celestial Alignment and have less than 40-Astral Power.
If you are not entering cooldowns, enter regular Eclipse.
Cast Fury of Elune if not entering Celestial Alignment.
Cast Starfire to generate Astral Power.
Cast Fury of Elune.
Cast Celestial Alignment
If you are not entering cooldowns, enter your regular Eclipse.
Cast Starfall to spend Astral Power, maintain Starlord, or to spend Touch the Cosmos.
Cast Force of Nature outside of Eclipse if you next button is Celestial Alignment.
Cast Celestial Alignment if you have just cast Force of Nature and then cast Starfire to spend Dream Surge if you will not cap on Astral Power.
Cast Force of Nature.
Spend Dream Surge using Starfire unless you will cap on Astral Power.
With 2-seconds on the pull-timer, cast two Wraths.
Use any on-use trinkets and potions.
Cast Celestial Alignment, use trinkets and potions.
Dump Astral Power on Starsurge if using Convoke the Spirits.
Cast Convoke the Spirits
Spend any remaining Dream Surge by casting Wrath.
Apply and maintain Sunfire and Moonfire
Cast Celestial Alignment.
Cast Fury of Elune (on multi-target, cast this before Celestial Alignment.
Spend your Astral Power.
Use Starfire to generate Astral Power.
Proceed with your standard rotation.
--- WoWhead Keeper of the Grove Rotation ---
Spread Moonfire while targets are being gathered
Apply Sunfire when all targets are gathered
Press Force of Nature if you have Incarnation: Chosen of Elune available or if Force of Nature will be available again before Incarnation: Chosen of Elune
Press Incarnation: Chosen of Elune if you just used Force of Nature
Cast Starsurge to consume Starweaver's Weft
Cast Wrath outside of Eclipse up to and including 6 targets.
Cast Starfire in Lunar Eclipse and Wrath in Solar Eclipse
Spread Moonfire to as many targets as possible
Apply Sunfire when all targets are gathered
Press Fury of Elune off cooldown
Press Incarnation: Chosen of Elune on the GCD after using Fury of Elune
Enter Lunar Eclipse if you're above 90% Astral Power and you're either about to overcap on charges or Fury of Elune is also available
Cast Starfire to generate Astral Power
